name: com.fullbasic.interpreter
description:
Full BASIC (ISO/IEC 10279:1991) interpreter for Unity. Run BASIC programs from C# for in-game scripting, dialogue, modding, education, or demos.

Features: arrays, MAT operations, file I/O, exception handling (WHEN/USE/HANDLER), modules, PRINT USING, INPUT, codepoint-aware strings, arbitrary-precision decimal arithmetic.

See README.md inside the package for quickstart and the InGameConsole sample for a working scene wiring.

samples.description: MonoBehaviour that runs a Full BASIC program from an inspector field and prints output to the Unity console.
